## Metric definitions

Numerator, denominator, statistical model and flagging thresholds.

#### AE Adverse Event Rate

- Numerator: Adverse Events
- Denominator: Days on Study
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: -2,-1,2,3

#### SAE Serious Adverse Event Rate

- Numerator: Serious Adverse Events
- Denominator: Days on Study
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: -2,-1,2,3

#### PD Non-Important Protocol Deviation Rate

- Numerator: Non-Important Protocol Deviations
- Denominator: Days on Study
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: -3,-2,2,3

#### IPD Important Protocol Deviation Rate

- Numerator: Important Protocol Deviations
- Denominator: Days on Study
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: -3,-2,2,3

#### LB Grade 3+ Lab Abnormality Rate

- Numerator: Grade 3+ Abnormal Labs Samples
- Denominator: Total Lab Samples
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### SDSC Study Discontinuation Rate

- Numerator: Subjects Discontinued - Study
- Denominator: Enrolled Subjects
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### PTDC Premature Treatment Discontinuation Rate

- Numerator: Enrolled and dosed participants who discontinue IP
  prematurely
- Denominator: Enrolled & Dosed Subjects
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### QRY Query Rate

- Numerator: Queries
- Denominator: Total Data Points
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### OQRY Delayed Query Resolution Rate

- Numerator: Queries That Were Open \> 30 Days
- Denominator: Total Queries
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### ODAT Delayed Data Entry Rate

- Numerator: Data Pages Entered \> 10 Days
- Denominator: Total Data Pages
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### CDAT Data Change Rate

- Numerator: Data Points with 1+ Change
- Denominator: Total Data Points
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### SF Screen Failure Rate

- Numerator: Screen Failures
- Denominator: Screened Subjects
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: -3,-2,2,3

#### PK PK Collection Compliance Rate

- Numerator: PK Samples Collected
- Denominator: PK Samples Expected
- Model: Identity
- Thresholds: 0.9,0.85

#### IE Ineligibility

- Numerator: Number of subjects ineligible
- Denominator: Number of subjects enrolled
- Model: Identity (Numerator)
- Thresholds: 1.5,2.5

#### DTH90 Premature Death Rate

- Numerator: Deaths in First 90 Days
- Denominator: Enrolled Subjects
- Model: Identity
- Thresholds: 1,2

#### IPNS IP Non-Starter Rate

- Numerator: IP Non-Starters (Confirmed or Potential outside window)
- Denominator: Enrolled Subjects
- Model: Identity
- Thresholds: 1,2

#### TDSC Treatment Discontinuation Rate Inactive

- Numerator: Subjects Discontinued - Treatment
- Denominator: Enrolled Subjects
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: 2,3

#### RET Retired Metric Inactive

- Numerator: Adverse Events
- Denominator: Days on Study
- Model: Normal Approximation
- Thresholds: -2,-1,2,3
